tagline: 美能达取景器相机，1934 年发布
description: 美能达于1934年推出的取景器相机。

specs.英文简介: The Minolta Vest (ミノルタ・ヴェスト) or Minolta Best (ミノルタ・ベスト) is a collapsible camera taking both 4×6.5cm and 3×4cm exposures on 127 film, made by Molta (the predecessor of Minolta) and distributed by Asanuma Shōkai from 1934 to the early 1940s.
